title: Record Schema assertion pack
description: A declarative set of cross-document checks over a record repository. Structural validation answers questions about one document; an assertion pack answers questions that only exist between two. A pack is data: it contains no code, no path into the host, and nothing a conforming implementation executes.

imports.description: Other packs to merge before this one. Later declarations win by identifier, which lets a repository ship a base pack and a narrowing pack without either copying the other. Paths are relative to the importing pack, or repository-relative when they begin with a slash.

default_source.description: Source used by a selector that names none.

sources.description: Named document sets. Selecting by declared document type rather than by filename glob is strongly preferred: a repository that names one payload two ways will silently drop half of them from a glob, and every rule built on that source then reports clean over documents it never opened.

tables.description: Named key/value maps, available to expressions. A table projected from the repository cannot drift from it; a table written out here can, so the literal form is for values the repository genuinely does not declare.

selectors.description: Named selectors, referenced by identifier from rules.

extends.description: Named selector to inherit from. Predicates compose rather than replace.

unit_where.description: Predicate over the whole document. Some conditions are properties of a document and cannot be decided from a node inside it.

each.description: Descend to children after `where` has filtered the scope. This is what lets one rule carry both a condition about a scope and a check over its members.

kind.description: Rule kinds are shapes of defect, not subjects. forbid: a match is the finding. require: every row satisfies a predicate. pattern: every value matches a form. unique: keys are distinct within a group. consistent: rows sharing a group agree on a value. resolve: every use resolves to a declaration. agree: two projections joined on a key relate as declared. derive: a computed value satisfies an expression. count: a group's cardinality falls within bounds. reach: every node is reached, modulo a categorised baseline. decode: declared bytes decode to the claimed fields. digest: a committed manifest matches the tree it names.

message.description: Rendered finding text. Required, because a rule reporting a token and no instruction tells a reader that something is wrong and not what to do about it.

severity.description: An advisory is an observation needing a human decision. It prints and never fails a run: a gate that fails on things it cannot itself adjudicate teaches people to silence it.

when.description: Expression guarding whether a derive assertion applies. A row the pack cannot resolve is not a row that fails; it is a row the check has nothing to say about.

compare.description: A join is not always an equality. A declared ceiling and the thing it bounds are joined on one key and related by an inequality.
